subject: planner: preserve col=col invariant in updateEQCond to fix panic (#66893)
summary: The change keeps `LogicalJoin.updateEQCond` EqualConditions as strict `col = col` even when `NewFunctionInternal` injects implicit casts, by materializing non-column sides via child projections and rebuilding the EQ; adds a regression test for issue #58999 to ensure no planner panic. Later history up to `upstream/master` shows no follow-up fix targeting this logic.
